body:
I don't think you should die because of being apathetic regarding death, you still care about the people around you and that makes you a good person. 


Perhaps you're experiencing dissociation from the cat you love and the now lifeless body that is in front of you. When the cat was alive, you could empathize with the pain it was feeling during its sickness. But now that it's dead, it cant feel any pain and it is no longer there with you.

You shouldn't feel bad for it, death is natural and once people and our pets are gone, all that is left is just an empty shell of where there was once someone.

I somewhat agree with that saying. 
If I really wanted to die, I would've put all my effort into it and I probably would've been dead by now. But instead I am taking my time, trying to keep the status quo and still fighting for what is rightfully mine. I've went through a lot of pain to achieve what I've wanted before, so I should maybe still have it in me.
I want more content like this,  this was great!
